name: Maine Eats: Restaurants
subtitle: Lobster Shack & Clam Guide
description:
Maine's restaurants, from the wharf-side lobster pounds to the diners on Route 1.

Maine Eats is a free guide to eating in Maine: lobster shacks and pounds, clam shacks, red snapper hot dogs and Maine Italians, whoopie pies and potato donuts, diners, oyster bars and dairy bars we checked open by hand, plus 4,216 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries in 319 Maine towns. No account, no ads.

MAINE GUIDES
• Lobster Shacks & Rolls: pounds, shacks and wharves from Kittery to Eastport, with each one's season where it posts it.
• Clam Shacks: whole-belly fried clams, chowder and clam cakes.
• Red Snappers & Italians: the bright-red natural-casing hot dog and the Maine Italian sandwich.
• Whoopie Pies & Donuts: whoopie pies, potato donuts and wild blueberry pie.
• Diners, Oyster Bars and Dairy Bars: long-running diners, Damariscotta River and Casco Bay oysters, and the summer ice cream stands.
• Maine Icons: James Beard honorees, America's Classics and places with 40 or more years at their address.
• Oldest Places: years at the same address, oldest first.

FIND IT FAST
• Sort by distance, or browse the map by lobster, clam shacks, sweets or dairy bars.
• Search by name, town, village or street: "lobster roll portland", "cape neddick", "route 1".
• Filter by town or cuisine, hide chains.
• Save places for your next trip.
• Find hand-checked places from iPhone search (Spotlight).

LIVE DETAILS FROM APPLE MAPS
Tap "Ratings, hours & photos" on a place to open Apple Maps' own place card, with current hours, photos, ratings and directions.

HOW THE LISTS ARE BUILT
Every place in the Maine guides was checked by hand in October 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source: its own website or menu, local news, or a town or chamber listing. Many coastal places are seasonal; a shack closed for the winter isn't closed. The rest of the restaurants come from Overture Maps open data and the State of Maine's liquor-license list; map listings are kept only at high confidence, measured against that list. Maine's official inspection result is Pass or Fail; where the City of Lewiston posts it, a place shows its latest result with the date. Website links are checked too. Nothing is ranked by star ratings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location, if you share it, only sorts lists on your device. Saved places stay on your device.

Places open and close, and many shacks are seasonal, so check before you go. Spot a mistake? Email nick@eatsranked.com.

An independent app, not affiliated with any restaurant, brand or government agency, or with the James Beard Foundation. James Beard Foundation and James Beard Award are trademarks of the James Beard Foundation. Place data from Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA Permissive 2.0) and others; sources and licenses are on the About tab.

reviewNotes:
1. Purpose and audience: Maine Eats is a free guide to restaurants in Maine. Its focus is the state's food traditions: lobster shacks and pounds (37 places), clam shacks, red snapper hot dogs and Maine Italian sandwiches, whoopie pies and potato donuts, diners, Damariscotta River oyster bars and summer dairy bars. Each was checked by hand in October 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source: the restaurant's own website or menu, local news, or a town or chamber listing. It also lists 4,216 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries in Maine's towns. It is for Maine residents and visitors deciding where to eat, with sourced facts and no ads, account or tracking.

2. How to use it (no login, no setup, no sample files needed):
- Guides tab (Home) → Lobster Shacks & Rolls (or Clam Shacks, Red Snappers & Italians, Whoopie Pies & Donuts, Diners, Oyster Bars, Dairy Bars, Maine Icons, Oldest Places, All Restaurants) → tap a place.
- On a place, tap "Ratings, hours & photos" to open Apple Maps' own place card through MapKit. Directions, Call and Website are below it.
- Search from the Home search box by name, town, village or street ("lobster roll portland", "cape neddick").
- The Map tab shows each guide as pins. "My location" and the Nearest sort use location only if allowed, on the device.
- The heart saves a place on the device, under the Saved tab. The About tab lists the data sources, licenses and the independence statement.
- On iPad, a sidebar replaces the tabs; a place opens in the right-hand column.
- Location: if you're outside Maine (as App Review usually is), the map says so and stays on Maine, and distance sorting still works from where you are.

3. External services and data:
- Apple MapKit: maps, local search to find a place's Apple Maps listing, and Apple's place card for live hours, photos and ratings.
- Core Location: optional, on-device only, for distance sorting.
- Core Spotlight: on-device indexing so places appear in iPhone search.
- No backend, accounts, analytics, advertising, payments or AI services. The restaurant data is bundled in the app.
- Bundled data: Overture Maps Foundation open place data (CDLA Permissive 2.0 / Apache 2.0 / CC0; license texts in the app); the State of Maine's public liquor-license data (trade names, addresses and license class only); the City of Lewiston's posted inspection results; U.S. Census town boundaries; James Beard award records (facts only); and our research of restaurants' own websites, menus and local news.
- The website with the privacy policy and support page is static and hosted on GitHub Pages: https://nickstrom5.github.io/maine-eats/

4. Regional differences: none. The content covers Maine; the app is offered in the United States and works the same everywhere.

5. Regulated or protected material: the app is not in a regulated industry and includes no protected third-party material. The data is open-licensed or public record, with attribution and licenses on the About tab. Ratings, hours and photos are shown only inside Apple's own place card through MapKit, under Apple's terms; the app stores no ratings or reviews. Maine's official inspection result is Pass or Fail; it appears only where the City of Lewiston posts it, labeled official with its date and a link to the city's report. Restaurant names are factual references. Every website link was checked before release, and adult venues are excluded. The app is independent and not affiliated with any restaurant, agency or the James Beard Foundation.

Support: nick@eatsranked.com
